articles.title: Messi in Tears After Argentina's Three-Goal Comeback Stuns Egypt in 13 Frantic Minutes
articles.excerpt: Trailing 2-0 with 11 minutes left, the defending champions score three — Romero, Messi, Fernandez in stoppage time — to survive the round of 16 and reach the World Cup quarterfinals
articles.image_caption: Lionel Messi celebrates after scoring Argentina's equaliser against Egypt in Atlanta
articles.nri_angle: The World Cup quarterfinals are being played across US cities — LA, Miami, Kansas City, Foxborough — bringing the drama to NRI doorsteps
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Seventy-Six All Out. Archer and Tongue Rip Through India for England's Biggest-Ever T20 Win.
articles.excerpt: World champions bowled out in 11.4 overs — their lowest total in 18 years and heaviest defeat in T20I history — as England seize a 2-0 series lead with two to play
articles.image_caption: Jofra Archer, who took 3-29 to dismantle India's top order at Trent Bridge
articles.nri_angle: India's humiliating T20I defeat raises concern among diaspora cricket fans, especially as England threaten to overtake India's No. 1 T20I ranking
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Twenty Goals. Thirty-Nine Years Old. Messi Faces Salah in Atlanta With a Quarterfinal Spot on the Line.
articles.excerpt: The final day of the World Cup's Round of 16 brings the tournament's biggest showdown yet — and completes the quarterfinal bracket that stretches from Foxborough to Miami.
articles.image_caption: Lionel Messi in Argentina colors at the 2022 FIFA World Cup in Qatar
articles.nri_angle: Millions of NRIs across the US can watch the World Cup's marquee matchups in their host cities — from Atlanta to Vancouver to LA — as football fever grips the Indian diaspora.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Belgium's Tactical Brilliance Overwhelms USA in Seattle Showdown
articles.excerpt: Belgium defeats USA 4-1 in front of a packed Lumen Field, securing their spot in the World Cup quarter-finals.
articles.image_caption: Lumen Field in Seattle, WA — venue for USA vs Belgium at the 2026 FIFA World Cup (Wikimedia Commons)
articles.nri_angle: Seattle's large Indian-American community added a vibrant cultural dimension to the World Cup match atmosphere.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Spain Edges Portugal as Mikel Merino's Late Strike Sends Iberian Rivals Packing
articles.excerpt: Mikel Merino's stoppage-time goal propels Spain past Portugal in a tense Round of 16 clash.
articles.image_caption: AT&T Stadium in Arlington, TX — venue for Portugal vs Spain at the 2026 FIFA World Cup (Wikimedia Commons)
articles.nri_angle: The Indian-American community in the Dallas-Fort Worth area, one of the largest in the U.S., embraced the World Cup with enthusiasm, adding a vibrant cultural layer to the match atmosphere.

articles.title: Haaland Scores Twice. Neymar Says Goodbye. Norway End Brazil's World Cup Dream at MetLife.
articles.excerpt: The Manchester City striker headed in the opener and fired an unstoppable second as Norway reached the quarterfinals for the first time. Brazil haven't made the last eight since 1990.
articles.image_caption: Erling Haaland celebrates after scoring his seventh World Cup goal against Brazil at MetLife Stadium
articles.nri_angle: NRI fans packed MetLife Stadium in New Jersey's Indian diaspora heartland to witness one of the biggest World Cup upsets in history.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Trail 1-0. Bishnoi's 29-Run Over Still Stings. Trent Bridge on Tuesday Is Do-or-Die.
articles.excerpt: England's shortest boundaries, India's youngest debutant, and a series that threatens to slip away before it's even half done. Here's everything at stake in the 3rd T20I.
articles.image_caption: Trent Bridge cricket ground in Nottingham, venue for the crucial 3rd T20I between England and India
articles.nri_angle: With the series slipping away, NRI cricket fans in the UK face a crucial midweek fixture while US-based fans can catch the action on Willow TV at lunchtime.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk
